name: King Legacy
tagline: Working King Legacy codes for free gems, stat resets and Beli boosts.
description: King Legacy is a Roblox One Piece-inspired adventure where players hunt Devil Fruits, master Haki and battle bosses across the seas. New codes drop after major updates, follower milestones, and developer livestreams. Most codes grant gems, stat resets or temporary XP and Beli boosts. Every code on this page has been cross-checked against the latest Pro Game Guides update list.

redeemSteps.title: Launch King Legacy
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox and start any King Legacy session. You can be on any island.

redeemSteps.title: Open the in-game menu
redeemSteps.detail: Press M on PC or tap the menu button on mobile to bring up the main menu.

redeemSteps.title: Tap the Twitter / X icon
redeemSteps.detail: Inside the menu, tap the small blue bird icon. The code entry box appears.

redeemSteps.title: Enter the code
redeemSteps.detail: Paste the code exactly as shown — codes are case-sensitive and often include numbers and underscores.

redeemSteps.title: Press Redeem
redeemSteps.detail: Working codes reward you instantly. If nothing happens, the code has likely expired.

faq.question: How often do King Legacy codes release?
faq.answer: Codes typically drop with each major update (every 2–6 weeks), plus extra codes for follower and like milestones on Twitter/X.

faq.question: Why is my King Legacy code not working?
faq.answer: King Legacy codes are case-sensitive and may include version numbers or special characters. Triple-check the spelling. If it still fails, it has likely expired — head to the Expired Codes page.

faq.question: Can I redeem the same code twice?
faq.answer: No. Each code can only be redeemed once per Roblox account.
